mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS turnover, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount FROM order_info o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 2 AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY statDate ORDER BY statDate ASC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS totalGmv, COUNT(*) AS totalOrders FROM order_info WHERE status != 2
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS todayGmv, COUNT(*) AS todayOrders FROM order_info WHERE status != 2 AND create_time >= CURDATE()

SELECT s.id AS stallId, s.name AS stallName, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS gmv, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount FROM stall s LEFT JOIN order_info o ON o.stall_id = s.id AND o.status != 2 GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY gmv DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stall WHERE status = 1
